description:
Job Title: Account Executive – Identity Security (Duo) (ASEAN)

About the Opportunity

Cisco's Identity Security business is one of the fastest-growing areas of our security portfolio, and Duo sits at the heart of it. This is a chance to own and grow a high-impact patch across the dynamic ASEAN market, working with some of the region's most influential organisations as they modernise how they secure identity and access. If you thrive on commercial ownership and enjoy turning complex security challenges into clear business wins, this role is for you.

Role Overview

As an Account Executive for Identity Security (Duo) in ASEAN, you will be the primary driver of revenue growth, tasked with expanding our market share and deepening customer relationships. You will own the sales cycle, influencing strategic decisions within the buying centre by positioning Cisco's identity security portfolio as a business enabler. While this role requires architectural fluency to articulate the value of Zero Trust and authentication solutions, your primary focus is on commercial success: displacing competitors, increasing wallet share, and managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales engagements across the diverse ASEAN landscape.

What You'll Do

Revenue Ownership: Drive the full sales lifecycle, from lead qualification to contract closure, achieving ambitious revenue targets within the ASEAN region.

Strategic Consultative Selling: Lead high-level discovery sessions with IT leadership, Line of Business (LOB) heads, and CXOs. You will translate complex technical architectures into compelling business outcomes that address specific customer pain points.

Competitive Positioning: Utilise market intelligence and competitor analysis to differentiate Cisco Identity Security (Duo). You will build and execute integrated account plans that neutralise competitor strategies and highlight our unique value proposition.

Deal Orchestration: Manage complex deal cycles (typically 3 to 18 months) with deal sizes ranging from 50Kto50Kto750K+ ACV. You will lead the development of technical proposals, including bill-of-materials (BOM) creation and financial business case justification.

Customer Engagement & Advocacy: Serve as the trusted advisor to your clients, ensuring they realise the full value of their investment. You will represent the "voice of the customer" to internal product teams, influencing roadmaps based on regional market demands.

Thought Leadership & Public Speaking: Represent Cisco Identity Security at industry conferences, customer events, and webinars, presenting to both technical and executive audiences.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner effectively with internal Solution Engineers, Account Teams, and business units to align resources, streamline the sales process, and minimise adoption barriers.

Forecasting & Planning: Maintain accurate pipeline hygiene and architectural-specific forecasting, ensuring alignment between technical projections and broader portfolio strategy.

Key Success Measures

Consistent achievement of quarterly and annual revenue targets.

Successful displacement of competitors and measurable growth in market share.

Development of long-term, high-value customer relationships and strategic account growth.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications: Bachelor's degree plus 7 years of related experience; or Master's degree plus 4 years of related experience.

Sales Acumen: Proven track record in a quota-carrying sales role, preferably within the cybersecurity or SaaS industry in the ASEAN market.

Technical Proficiency: Ability to articulate complex security architectures (specifically Zero Trust, phish-resistant MFA, and Access Management) to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Regional Expertise: Strong understanding of the ASEAN business landscape and the ability to navigate complex, multi-national account structures.

Travel: Travel across the ASEAN region required.

Preferred Qualifications

Direct experience selling Identity and Access Management (IAM) or MFA solutions.

Established CXO-level relationships across key ASEAN markets.

Multilingual capability relevant to the ASEAN region.

Comfortable presenting to large audiences at conferences, industry events, and customer briefings.

Why Cisco? 

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
